```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)


# Helper packages
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Modeling packages
library(earth)
library(caret)

# Model interpretability packages
library(vip)          # for variable importance
library(pdp)          # for variable relationships
library(ModelMetrics) # for access MSE, MAE

bool_rerun = FALSE
```


# read-in
```{r}
frag_cut_file  = "~/iproject/BSReadSim/test/data/RRBS/frag_cut_df2.csv"
mars_ident_rds = "~/iproject/BSReadSim/test/data/RRBS/spline_ident.rds"
mars_logit_rds = "~/iproject/BSReadSim/test/data/RRBS/spline_logit.rds"
mars_cv_ident_rds = "~/iproject/BSReadSim/test/data/RRBS/spline_cv_ident.rds"
mars_cv_logit_rds = "~/iproject/BSReadSim/test/data/RRBS/spline_cv_logit.rds"


frag_cut_df = read.table(frag_cut_file, sep = ",", header = TRUE) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(logit_prob = log(relative_depth/(1-relative_depth)))

data_ident = frag_cut_df[c("length", "gc_ratio", "CCGG", "relative_depth")]
data_logit = frag_cut_df[c("length", "gc_ratio", "CCGG", "logit_prob")]
```

```{r}
head(frag_cut_df)
```



# liner regression
```{r}
lm_ident = lm(relative_depth ~., data = data_ident)
lm_logit = lm(logit_prob ~., data = data_logit)
```

```{r}
summary(lm_ident)
cat(paste0(paste(rep('-', 75), collapse = ""), "\n"))
summary(lm_logit)
```


# beta regression
```{r}
library(betareg)
br = betareg(relative_depth ~., data_ident)
# cannot summary, #Error: cannot allocate vector of size 590.3 Gb
cor(br$fitted.values, br$model$relative_depth)^2
```



# spline fit
on original relative_depth or logit transformed
```{r}
if(bool_rerun){
  mars_ident = earth(relative_depth ~ ., data = data_ident, degree=3) #glm=list(family=binomial)
  saveRDS(mars_ident, file = mars_ident_rds)
  
  mars_logit = earth(logit_prob ~ ., data = data_logit, degree=3)
  saveRDS(mars_logit, file = mars_logit_rds)
}else{
  mars_ident = readRDS(mars_ident_rds)
  mars_logit = readRDS(mars_logit_rds)
}
```


```{r}
summary(mars_ident)
cat(paste0(paste(rep('-', 75), collapse = ""), "\n"))
summary(mars_logit)
```


```{r}
plot(mars_ident, which = 1)
plot(mars_logit, which = 1)
```


# spline cross-validation
cross validation to select the best model
```{r}
hyper_grid <- expand.grid(
  degree = 1:5, 
  nprune = seq(2, 100, length.out = 10) %>% floor()
)

if(bool_rerun){
  library(doParallel)
  cl <- makePSOCKcluster(20)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
  mars_cv_ident <- train(
    x = subset(data_ident, select = -relative_depth),
    y = data_ident$relative_depth,
    method = "earth",
    metric = "RMSE",
    trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10),
    tuneGrid = hyper_grid,
  )
  
  stopCluster(cl)
  
  saveRDS(mars_cv_ident, file = mars_cv_ident_rds)
  
  cl <- makePSOCKcluster(20)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
  mars_cv_logit <- train(
    x = subset(data_logit, select = -logit_prob),
    y = data_logit$logit_prob,
    method = "earth",
    metric = "RMSE",
    trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10),
    tuneGrid = hyper_grid,
  )
  
  stopCluster(cl)
  
  saveRDS(mars_cv_logit, file = mars_cv_logit_rds)
}else{
  mars_cv_ident = readRDS(mars_cv_ident_rds)
  mars_cv_logit = readRDS(mars_cv_logit_rds)
}

head(hyper_grid)
```


```{r}
summary(mars_cv_ident)
cat(paste0(paste(rep('-', 75), collapse = ""), "\n"))
summary(mars_cv_logit)
```


# GAM
```{r}
library(mgcv)
library(splines)

model <- mgcv::bam(logit_prob ~ ns(length, df=3) + ns(CCGG, df=3) + ns(gc_ratio, df=3), 
                   method = "fREML", data = data_logit)
model <- mgcv::bam(relative_depth ~ ns(length, df=10) + ns(CCGG, df=10) + ns(gc_ratio, df=10), 
                   method = "fREML", data = data_ident, family = binomial(link = "probit"))
model <- mgcv::bam(relative_depth ~ ns(length, df=20) + ns(CCGG, df=20) + ns(gc_ratio, df=20), 
                   method = "fREML", data = data_ident, family = betar)
```




# visualize the prediction results
```{r}
library(ggpointdensity)
library(viridis)

pred_df_ident = data.frame(real = mars_cv_ident$finalModel$y %>% as.vector(),
                           fitted = mars_cv_ident$finalModel$fitted.values %>% as.vector())
pred_df_logit = data.frame(real = mars_cv_logit$finalModel$y %>% as.vector(),
                           fitted = mars_cv_logit$finalModel$fitted.values %>% as.vector())

ggplot(pred_df_ident, mapping = aes(x = fitted, y = real)) +
  #stat_density2d(aes(alpha = ..density..), geom = "tile", contour = FALSE) +
  geom_pointdensity() +
  scale_color_viridis()

ggplot(pred_df_logit, mapping = aes(x = fitted, y = real)) +
  #stat_density2d(aes(alpha = ..density..), geom = "tile", contour = FALSE) +
  geom_pointdensity() +
  scale_color_viridis()
```



```{r}
smoothScatter(lm_ident$model$relative_depth, lm_ident$fitted.values, main = "linear regression",
              xlab = "relative depth", ylab = "predicted depth", xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1))
smoothScatter(sigmoid(lm_logit$model$logit_prob), sigmoid(lm_logit$fitted.values), main = "linear regression (logit transformation)",
              xlab = "relative depth", ylab = "predicted depth", xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1))
smoothScatter(br$model$relative_depth, br$fitted.values, main = "beta regression",
              xlab = "relative depth", ylab = "predicted depth", xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1))
smoothScatter(model$model$relative_depth, model$fitted.values, main = "GAM",
              xlab = "relative depth", ylab = "predicted depth", xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1))
smoothScatter(sigmoid(mars_cv_logit$trainingData$.outcome), sigmoid(mars_cv_logit$finalModel$fitted.values), main = "Multivariate spline",
              xlab = "relative depth", ylab = "predicted depth", xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1))
```
